method: captured live on 2026-09-10 via raw CDP through the operator's Chrome with the Taobao session LOGGED OUT — the exact state that produces this wall. Trimmed only of <script>/<style>/<noscript> blocks, HTML comments, and image src/srcset values (blanked); all 32 anchors, the search inputs, meta tags and the visible text stay verbatim; the full raw page stays outside git in .agent/captures/taobao_search_login_wall_raw.html.
